name: Modern Art
summary: Auction game where players speculate on five artists' paintings over four rounds to earn the most money.
rules_text: Each player gets a hand of painting cards (five artists, each card shows an auction type) and hidden money. In turn order players auction one card from hand: open ascending bids, fixed price named by auctioneer and first to accept buys, once-around where each player bids once must raise, sealed simultaneous bids, or double auction of two same-artist cards using second card's type. Buyer pays auctioneer, or bank if auctioneer wins; if no bids in open, auctioneer gets it free, in fixed must buy. Cards played stay on table. Round ends when a fifth card of any artist is played (that card is discarded). Then artists are ranked by number of cards played that round; top three earn value markers on board. All owned paintings of those artists pay owners equal to total value in artist's column. Used paintings are discarded. After four such rounds player with most money wins.
rating_reason: Multi-type auction game, bidding and bluffing, fits engine
